load.workload: 60 warm requests, 3 sample questions, real semantic retrieval/extractive generation, shared project key, no streaming; sequential stages. Other development stacks remained running; host contention was not controlled. No deliberate competing load. HTTP includes auth, durable query storage and metric overhead.
load.protocol_context_note: Executed on a fresh GitHub-hosted runner with source and separate recovery Compose projects. The retained original workload wording about historical development stacks describes the local run, not this CI environment; the QA script wording is corrected for future runs.
